translations.torneo.lideres.aparecen-solos-medida-mes: They appear automatically as the table closes kumite matches or records kata scores.

It is for recognition, not an official ranking.

translations.torneo.reglas.valen-para-todas-categoria: They apply to all categories; each category can change them.
translations.torneo.resultados.aparecen-pie-cada-dipl: They appear at the bottom of each diploma, along with the tournament, city and date.
translations.torneo.resultados.apareceran-aqui-medida: They will appear here as matches finish.
translations.torneo.resultados.sin-medallas-todavia-s: No medals yet. Only finished categories count.

translations.torneo.resumen.copia-categorias-plantill: Copies the categories from a template into the tournament. Then you can edit, merge or cancel them.
translations.torneo.resumen.direccion-fija-pagina-pub: Fixed address of the public page
translations.torneo.resumen.dojos-pueden-inscribir-ci: Dojos can register. Close registration to generate the brackets.

translations.torneo.resumen.genera-llaves-asigna-tata: Generate the brackets and assign tatamis; then start the tournament.
translations.torneo.resumen.hay-cosas-conviene-resolv: There are things worth resolving before starting: without them, some matches will not reach the tables.
translations.torneo.resumen.minusculas-sin-tildes-num: Lowercase without accents, numbers and hyphens.
translations.torneo.resumen.no-hay-nada-impida-inicia: Nothing prevents starting, but it is worth reviewing:
translations.torneo.resumen.no-pudo-copiar-selecciona: Could not copy: select the link and copy it manually
translations.torneo.resumen.overlay-transmision-fuent: Streaming overlay (1920×1080 browser source, transparent background)
translations.torneo.resumen.pagina-publica-para-famil: A public page for families and spectators, and a scoreboard to stream live with OBS or vMix. No sign-in: anyone with the link can view it.
translations.torneo.resumen.prepara-categorias-datos-: Prepare categories and data; then open registration.
translations.torneo.resumen.queda-1-problema: 1 important issue remains unresolved. Start the tournament anyway?
translations.torneo.resumen.quedan-problemas: {$n} important issues remain unresolved. Start the tournament anyway?
translations.torneo.resumen.reabrir-torneo-finalizado: Reopening a finished tournament is audited (who, when and why).
translations.torneo.resumen.solo-admin-global-puede-r: Only the Global Admin can reopen a finished tournament.
translations.torneo.resumen.solo-publican-nombres-doj: Only names, dojos, scores, estimated times, brackets, results and medal table are published; never documents or dates of birth.
translations.torneo.resumen.todo-orden-categorias-lla: All in order: categories with bracket and tatami, and tatamis with an operator.
translations.torneo.solicitudes.enlace-dejara-funcion: The link will stop working. Senseis who already used it keep their access to the dojo.
translations.torneo.solicitudes.enlace-dojo-vincula-s: A per-dojo link binds the sensei as administrator of that dojo (if the dojo already has another one, the request comes to you here). The general link works for any dojo and always asks for your approval.
translations.torneo.solicitudes.no-pudo-copiar-selecc: Could not copy: select the link and copy it manually
translations.torneo.solicitudes.revisalas-puedes-move: Review them: you can move them to another category or reject them.
translations.torneo.solicitudes.sensei-vera-este-moti: The sensei will see this reason.
translations.torneo.solicitudes.senseis-administrador: Senseis (dojo administrators) register their students with the same suggestions and warnings you see. Their registrations stay pending until you approve them: they do not enter the brackets in the meantime.
translations.torneo.sombra.comparacion-resultado-ofic: Comparison with the official result. Record what the official table (paper) says for each match; differences are flagged and feed the success criteria.
translations.torneo.sombra.decision-banderas-no-hay: Flag decision: there is no score to compare
translations.torneo.sombra.no-hay-combates-finalizado: There are no finished matches to compare.
translations.torneo.tatamis.agrega-uno-para-empezar: Add one to start scheduling matches.
translations.torneo.tatamis.competidores-combates-pen: Competitors with pending matches on another tatami:
translations.torneo.tatamis.elige-categorias-sin-tata: Choose categories without a tatami and assign them; in each tatami order them with ↑ ↓ and save. The number of matches is an estimate based on entrants and format.
translations.torneo.tatamis.hora-inicio-cada-tatami-e: With each tatami's start time, the start time of each match is estimated (category duration plus the margin, adjusted with the tatami's real pace). It is shown on the public page, in «When do they compete?» and in the queues.
translations.torneo.tatamis.registro-oficial-papel-pa: Official paper record for Shadow Mode

translations.usuarios.cuentas-acceso-hajime: Accounts with access to Hajime. New or reset passwords require choosing one's own password when signing in.
translations.usuarios.debe-elegir-contrasena-nueva: Must choose a new password when signing in
translations.usuarios.dejara-ser-administrador-global: {$username} will no longer be a global administrator.
translations.usuarios.entrega-esta-contrasena-no: Give this password to {$START_TAG_STRONG}{$INTERPOLATION}{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}. {$START_TAG_STRONG}It will not be shown again.{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}

translations.usuarios.no-podra-ingresar-cerraran: {$username} will not be able to sign in and their open sessions will be closed. You can reactivate them whenever you want.
translations.usuarios.persona-vinculada-define-roles: The linked person defines this account's roles (organizer, table operator…).

translations.usuarios.primer-ingreso-debera-elegir: On first sign-in they will have to choose their own password.
translations.usuarios.sirve-para-recuperar-contrasena: It is used to recover the password. We will send them a link to confirm it; until then it stays «not verified».
